checks.isoGU: isoGU : GSE E ≃* GU E is QuotientGroup.quotientKerEquivOfSurjective of unitPartHom g = |det g|^{-1/n} g, after ker_unitPartHom = posHomotheties. isoGU_mk gives i(ḡ) = |det g|^{-1/n} g and isoGU_symm_apply proves i⁻¹ = the projection GL → GS restricted to GU, which is exactly « la projection de GL(n,R) sur son quotient GS(n−1,R) définit donc un isomorphisme (noté i) de GS(n−1,R) sur GU(n,R) ». glEquivProd : GL ≃* ℝ⁺ × GU with inverse (c,u) ↦ c·u and posHomothetiesEquiv : ℝ⁺ ≃* posHomotheties are « produit direct du sous-groupe, isomorphe à R⁺, … et du sous-groupe GU ». isoGUR m : GSR m ≃* GUR (m+1) is the paper's index (GS(n−1) ≅ GU(n)). Hypotheses: FiniteDimensional is NEEDED — in infinite dimension LinearEquiv.det is the junk value 1, so GU E = ⊤ and GSE E ≃* GU E would be false; Nontrivial is needed for glEquivProd (GL(0) is trivial, not ℝ⁺ × GU(0)) but NOT for isoGU (both sides trivial at E = 0)

Hypotheses [ContinuousAdd E] [ContinuousSMul ℝ E] are needed (with the discrete topology on E, S(E) is discrete and rigidity fails); [T1Space E] is used only through Sphere.isOpen_iff_F and is not needed mathematically (s⁻¹(U) relatively open in E − {O} already contains a segment of the line x + t·y, which avoids 0). `example : IsAnalyticAction (GSR m) (S m)` and ContinuousConstSMul (GSR m) (S m) elaborate, ready for gxGroupoid (GSR n) (S n)

issues.problem: The quoted block starts « Le quotient GS(n−1,R) … », which is benzecri1960_ch1.tex:294; l.296 is mid-sentence (« le quotient GP(n−1,R) … »). The REPORT's prose.where correctly says 294–302

GU E is defined for every real vector space, but LinearEquiv.det is the junk value 1 outside finite dimension, so there GU E = ⊤. The docstring ('the automorphisms whose determinant has absolute value 1') does not say so
issues.fix: Add 'meaningful for finite-dimensional E (LinearEquiv.det is 1 otherwise, so GU E = ⊤)'

issues.problem: [Nontrivial E] is section-wide; it is needed for glEquivProd but not for isoGU, which holds at E = 0 trivially. The checklist row attributes n ≥ 1 to the whole decomposition
issues.fix: Optional: state isoGU without [Nontrivial E] (case on Subsingleton E), or note in the row that only the product decomposition needs n ≥ 1

issues.problem: [T1Space E] is stronger than rigidity needs (see checks.rigidity); harmless for every space Ch. 1 uses
issues.fix: None needed; optionally note it in the docstring of mem_posHomotheties_of_eqOn

issues.problem: GAR = AffineEquiv presupposes the linear reading of Déf. 2, which WP-45b leaves as an open question to the author (under the printed Déf. 2, the « automorphismes de la structure d'espace affin » would include ℚ-affine bijections)
issues.fix: Add a one-line cross-reference to WP-45b's Déf. 2 question in GAR's docstring or SCOPE

fidelity_summary: Every sentence of the p. 236 prose that is formalized says what Benzécri says, at his indices: GS = GL/ℝ⁺ acting on S, GL = ℝ⁺ × GU, i : GS ≃* GU with the paper's description of i⁻¹, GA generated by GL and translations. The rigidity theorem is real (faithful + rigid on any T1 real TVS), not obtained from a hypothesis. Its hypotheses are the needed ones, with T1 and, for isoGU, Nontrivial slightly more than needed.
